The Network Info Panel renders your network history as smooth curves on a wall-sized multi-block screen.

It does not just record EU wireless network status — connected to an ME network, it also tracks real-time and historical item changes inside it.

How it works: EU wireless readings follow the placing player's own wireless network; for the ME side, right-click the panel while holding an item or fluid cell to configure what to monitor. You can also open its terminal for more detailed settings.

Its edge: extremely low performance and memory consumption while recording up to a full year of network history — 8 nested time windows (5m/1h/8h/24h/7d/1M/3M/1Y) on a 61-point FIFO, drawn as Fritsch-Carlson splines. All screens placed by the same player share one dataset.
